# Ta-Ta

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Supermarket chain in Uruguay with an online store on the VTEX platform, selling groceries, beverages, household and personal care, and small appliances. Home delivery is limited to 15 listed localities; customers elsewhere can order but must choose a branch pickup. Free home delivery above a stated threshold.

La entrega a domicilio se limita a 15 localidades; desde otras zonas se puede comprar, pero se retira en sucursal. Envío gratis por encima de un monto indicado.
